campaign_note: utm_campaign: the series slug (metadata.json campaign), else this, else the video's folder name. utm_content = <video>_<placement>_<link id>, so each spot reports on its own.
short_links: Bitly through its API: yt shorten NAME (and after every draft, when the token is in the Keychain as bitly-api)

bitly.note: HubSpot's Bitly account: HubSpot content only. Used only for videos explicitly on the hubspot profile (an edited video's storyboard, or notes.txt saying HubSpot for an inbox video, or yt shorten NAME --hubspot). Token in the Keychain as bitly-hubspot. per_placement false = one short link per link id (description and pinned comment share it), for a plan's monthly cap. group_guid empty = the account's default group. domain: the account's branded domain (hsdev.fyi); a stored link on another domain is remade.

series_links_note: Every video in a series gets these links in the description (after the first link), when each resolves; a link marked not live in LINKS.md is left out and named in for_dennis.

drive.root: Shared drives/Builder Relations Team/Builder Growth/Content/Video Content
drive.note: yt drive NAME copies the finished video, thumbnails, captions and YOUTUBE.md to <root>/<year>/<month>/<series>/ (Drive for desktop). DRIVE_ROOT in pipeline/config.sh overrides the path on a Mac whose Drive sits elsewhere.
